verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an account-based filing service, but the evidence pack documents no user-facing retention settings, deletion requests, or account or data-erasure controls. The only related item is the option to store card details in Financial Manager or enter them at payment time. That is an adjacent payment-convenience choice, not a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
